conditions: Scripted 3-round sequences, one special cast then Basic Attack. Wounded two-hero party, 1/3 mixed 65-raw threats, 0/30 armor and 0/20 MR, fixed tactical positions. Baseline replaces the special with Basic Attack; no-effect pairs hold damage fixed and disable its proc; immediate Arcane holds payoff/mana/cooldown fixed and removes charging. Each case retains endpoints and blocked turns; its first seed also retains full effects, events and action traces. All charge-risk pairs retain full traces. Formation is deliberately favorable and is not a target-coverage probability.
